About:

Meet Cotton | Apply Here

Cotton is also a part of the ‘C’ litter - she’s 8 months old and 18lbs of lanky legs and cuteness. If you had asked us about her a few days ago, we would have explained she’s shy but blossoming. But boy did she blossom quickly!

This little lady decided at our adoption event yesterday that she was the star of the show. She eagerly approached visitors and accepted all of the treats she could. For her first event and it being in Manhattan, she’s a pretty confident girlie! As her curiosity grows, her tail keeps up and wagging more often. She’s peppy on her walks and loves to explore anything she can get into.

Cotton is also doing well with her crate training and potty training! She’s a huge fan of toys - just like her siblings - so her forever family should prepare to have lots of toys thrown all over throughout the house. She really likes having a variety at her paw tips.

If you’ve got puppy fever too, tap that link in our bio and send your application on over. You can interview via zoom and get your pre-approved status before our next event!

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.
